text:
laura: quick sync — external pentest incoming. objective: keep scope tight, reproducible evidence stream, and one consolidated retest.
ben: timeline?
kyle: suggest Wed 2026-06-09 09:30-12:00 PT for retest. gives us EU morning overlap.
laura: ok lock infra freeze 36h pre-retest. freeze starts Mon 09:30 PT.
natalie: what access does the assessor need? full read of logs or ephemeral viewer?
laura: ephemeral assume-role only, role expires after session. we will not hand out list-buckets perms. large artifacts shared via time-limited URLs.
ben: logging: need full correlated traces (requestID, traceID) and model-serving metadata (model id, quantization flags).
kyle: will export traces -> s3 under prefix redwood-pen-tests/<ticket>/ and include a manifest.csv with SHA256 checksums, and a small sample of sanitized request bodies. retention 120 days.
laura: KMS constraints: assessor must not be able to decrypt or re-encrypt. Allow DescribeKey and GetPublicKey where relevant.
ben: propose an explicit Deny statement for kms:Decrypt and kms:ReEncrypt* on the ephemeral role. also log kms:GenerateDataKey calls to track any envelope usage.
ops-bot: ticket PT-9012 created for this engagement.
kyle: remediation tracker: PT-9012 parent. fixes become subtasks with severity, CVSS, estimated ETA. we expect CSV export 48h before retest to allow assessor prep.
laura: acceptance rules: verifier must confirm the vulnerability no longer reproduces on the retest runbook env; otherwise classify as partial with mitigation. we record verification note and close only child ticket.
ben: RBAC during fixes: prefer temporary privilege escalation gated by feature flags, auto-revert after test. no permanent wide IAM changes.
kyle: runbook snippets:
```
# fetch logs for retest id
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-archive/1765018000/serve_logs.tgz ./ --region us-west-2
sha256sum serve_logs.tgz > serve_logs.tgz.sha256
```
laura: add one channel observer during retest to triage noise — natalie can do 09:30-11:00, I will cover the handoff.
natalie: i'll draft the preflight checklist: artifact prefixes, IAM policy ARN, expected events to capture (STS:AssumeRole, KMS:Decrypt attempts, API Gateway request ids). sharing link when done.
laura: legal/compliance needs a short briefing that no PII will be provided to the assessor and that logs are redacted. i'll ping them for a sign-off.
ben: anything else?
kyle: we should also snapshot deployment manifests and model version tags (immutable). saves time during repro.
laura: thanks; i'll publish the final checklist and artifact locations by EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
